info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Pro — Integration Hub
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Pro — Integration Hub.** Third-party integrations: connections, connectors, flows and runs, triggers, inbound hooks, OAuth, governance, quotas, anomaly detection and the integration agent.

get.summary: pro-integrations plugin status / dependency probe

200.description: Plugin identity plus the two graceful-degradation flags: whether pro-ai is bound and whether the Studio Agent is usable.

get.summary: Effective tier features + per-org limits (FE feature-gating)

200.description: Effective limits (0 = unlimited) and tier entitlements. All-permissive when the host binds no FeatureGateService.

get.summary: Flow Engine (Activepieces) sidecar health

200.description: The sidecar's health probe. Returns `{ online: false, error }` — not an HTTP error — when no adapter is bound or the probe fails.

get.summary: Browse the connector catalog (global + org), filtered

200.description: Enabled connectors visible to the org (global ∪ org-owned), ordered by kind then name.

get.summary: Get a single connector by key

200.description: The org-owned entry wins over a global one with the same key. 404 when no entry matches.

post.summary: Re-seed the global connector catalog (native + generic + engine)

201.description: Idempotent upsert counts. Live engine entries win by key over the static seed.

post.summary: Import an OpenAPI 3.x spec as an org connector (kind=openapi)

201.description: The persisted org-scoped connector, with one action per derived operation.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Register an MCP server; its tools become connector actions (kind=mcp)

201.description: The persisted org-scoped connector, one action per discovered MCP tool. The discovery bearer token is not persisted.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List connections (secrets masked)

200.description: The org's connections, newest first. Only the masked `keyHint` is exposed, never a secret.

post.summary: Create a connection — api-key/basic stores the secret; oauth2 returns an authorize URL

201.description: For api_key/basic/none: the created connection. For oauth2: only `authorizeUrl` — redirect the browser there; the connection row is created by the callback.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get a single connection

200.description: The connection. Secrets stay in the vault; only the masked `keyHint` is returned.

delete.summary: Revoke a connection and purge its vaulted secret

200.description: The row is deleted and its vault entry purged.

get.summary: Get the org OAuth client config for a connector (secret masked)

200.description: The OAuth app config; `configured: false` with no other fields when none is set. The client secret is never returned — only `secretHint`.

put.summary: Set the org OAuth client config (client secret vaulted)

200.description: The stored config re-read after the write; the submitted client secret is vaulted and masked.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete the org OAuth client config (purges the vaulted secret)

200.description: `deleted: false` when nothing was configured for this connector.

get.summary: OAuth2 redirect callback (public; verified by state + PKCE)

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

get.summary: List flows

200.description: The org's flows, most recently updated first. Metadata only — no step graph.

201.description: The created flow in 'draft' status with its version-1 definition.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: AI-author a FlowDefinition from a natural-language description
post.description: Returns a draft FlowDefinition for human review on the canvas; it is never auto-activated. Requires the pro-ai plugin (503 when absent).

201.description: A draft definition plus its validation verdict. Nothing is persisted — POST /pro/flows to save it.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get a flow with its head definition

200.description: The flow plus the definition of its head version.

put.summary: Update a flow; a new definition appends an immutable version

200.description: The updated flow; `headVersion` is bumped when a definition was sent.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: Versions, triggers and run history cascade with the flow.

post.summary: Compile the head version to the engine and activate

201.description: The flow in 'active' status with `engineRef` set. 503 when the engine could not compile it.
The flow in 'paused' status; its triggers stop firing.

post.summary: Manually run a flow (returns the queued runId)

201.description: The run is queued, not executed inline — poll GET /pro/integrations/runs/:id. 429 when the org is over its runs/min or runs/day quota.

get.summary: List a flow’s immutable versions

200.description: Version metadata, newest first. Fetch a definition via /versions/:version.

get.summary: Get a specific version’s definition

200.description: The immutable definition stored for that version number.

get.summary: List a flow’s triggers

200.description: The flow’s triggers in creation order. Webhook secrets appear only as the masked `secretHint`.

post.summary: Add a trigger (inbound_webhook returns the secret once)

201.description: The created trigger. For `inbound_webhook` the response additionally carries `secretPlaintext` — the HMAC signing key in PLAINTEXT, returned exactly once and never readable again.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The updated trigger. A schedule trigger’s `nextFireAt` is recomputed from the cron (null while disabled).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete a trigger (purges any vaulted webhook secret)

200.description: Always true when the trigger existed; its vaulted HMAC secret is purged.

post.summary: Inbound webhook trigger (HMAC + timestamp + nonce verified)

200.description: The run queued for the trigger’s flow. 404 for an unknown/inactive webhook, 401 on signature failure, 409 on a replayed nonce, 429 past 60 requests/minute per tracker.

get.summary: List flow runs (filter: flow, status)

200.description: Runs newest first. `limit` is clamped to 1…200 and defaults to 50; there is no total count.

get.summary: Get a run with its step timeline (hashed payloads)

200.description: The run plus its step records. Step payloads are sha256 hashes, never raw data.

201.description: The run re-read after re-queueing (status 'queued'); prior step records are cleared. 400 unless the run was failed or cancelled.
The cancelled run. 400 when the run is already in a terminal state; only queued/running/waiting_confirmation can be cancelled.

post.summary: Resume a run awaiting human confirmation (grants the needed consents)

201.description: The re-queued run. The consents its preflight flagged are granted for the session, attributed to the caller. 400 unless the run was 'waiting_confirmation'.

get.summary: Get the org egress policy (defaults when unset)

200.description: The stored policy, or the built-in defaults with `configured: false` when the org has never saved one.
The merged, persisted policy (omitted fields keep their previous value). 403 without the Business entitlement.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List consents

200.description: The whole ledger for the org (including revoked/expired rows), most recently granted first.

201.description: The newly granted consent, attributed to the caller. `lifetime` defaults to 'session'.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The row is marked revoked (append-only — nothing is deleted). 404 when already revoked or unknown.

get.summary: List audit entries (paginated, filterable)

200.description: Offset-paged entries. Paging is reported inside the payload as `rows`/`limit`/`offset` (not the envelope `meta`), and no total count is computed.

get.summary: GDPR export of audit entries (Business; optionally for one user)

200.description: A flat array capped at 10 000 entries, newest first — narrowed to one data subject when `userId` is given. 403 without the Business entitlement.

post.summary: Open a new Studio Agent session

201.description: The new session. An unrecognised `mode` falls back to 'assist'. 503 without pro-ai; 403 without the Business entitlement.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List recent agent sessions

200.description: The 100 most recent sessions for the org, newest first (no transcripts).

get.summary: Get a session with its messages + action log

200.description: The session plus its full transcript and every recorded action, oldest first.

post.summary: Send a message — plans, runs safe tools inline, pauses for HITL on effectful tools

201.description: One planner turn: the assistant reply, the actions it touched, and those still pending confirmation. When the org's daily agent-token budget is spent the turn returns immediately with `stopped: 'agent-token-budget'`.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Confirm a pending action — grants consent and executes it once

201.description: The action re-read after execution ('executed' or 'failed'). 409 when it already ran, 400 when it is not pending or the session egress budget is spent.
The action in 'denied' status; it is never executed. 400 when it is not pending.

get.summary: Get the effective rate/quota policy for the org

200.description: Per-org overrides merged over the §16 defaults — every field is always present.

put.summary: Override rate/quota limits for the org

200.description: The merged, persisted policy (omitted fields keep their current value). A license-tier ceiling may still cap the effective runs/day and agent tokens.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Today's usage snapshot (runs, egress bytes, agent tokens, concurrency)

200.description: Metered counters for the current UTC day plus live run counts derived from pro_flow_runs. Compare against GET /quota.

get.summary: List recent anomaly alerts for the org

200.description: The `kind: 'anomaly'` slice of the audit log, newest first — each `payload` is `{ type, detail }` and `egressTarget` names the host. Same envelope as GET /pro/integrations/audit.

get.summary: Prometheus metrics (spec §16)

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

get.summary: Admin-UI translations for a locale (ngx-translate http-loader)

200.description: The locale catalog as a flat translation-key → string map. Unknown locales return `{}` so ngx-translate falls back to `en`. Public — no auth.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND)

message.description: Human-readable message; validation errors return one message per violation

path.description: Request path that produced the error

requestId.description: Correlation ID (echoes the X-Request-Id header) for support and log lookup

kind.description: Which part of the action space the tool came from

destructive.description: Mutates state irreversibly — always requires confirmation

egress.description: Sends data to an external system — always requires confirmation

args.description: Resolved tool arguments, replayed verbatim on confirm. Shape follows the tool's own JSON Schema, so it is free-form; it may reference a `connectionId` but never contains credentials.

result.description: Execution result summary, shaped by the tool that ran (e.g. `{ enqueued, runId }` for a flow tool, `{ task, result }` for an AI utility). Absent while pending.

error.description: Error message when the action failed

content.description: Stored message body. User messages are `{ text, context }`; assistant messages are `{ text, toolCalls[] }`. Free-form because the planner transcript shape follows the gateway contract.

model.description: Requested model; null uses the gateway default

mode.description: Planning mode. 'assist' proposes and pauses; 'auto' is recorded but egress and destructive tools ALWAYS require confirmation regardless (decision §19.5).

toolCallsUsed.description: Tool calls consumed against the per-session cap (20)

egressBytesUsed.description: Bytes sent externally, against the per-session cap (5 MiB)

actions.description: Every action recorded in this session, oldest first

model.description: Requested model; null uses the gateway default

mode.description: Planning mode. 'assist' proposes and pauses; 'auto' is recorded but egress and destructive tools ALWAYS require confirmation regardless (decision §19.5).

toolCallsUsed.description: Tool calls consumed against the per-session cap (20)

egressBytesUsed.description: Bytes sent externally, against the per-session cap (5 MiB)

assistant.description: The assistant's final natural-language reply for this turn

actions.description: Actions touched this turn — safe tools already executed plus any newly pending ones

pending.description: Subset of `actions` still awaiting human confirmation before they run

stopped.description: Set when the turn ended early instead of on a final answer

promptTokens.description: Prompt tokens summed over the turn

completionTokens.description: Completion tokens summed over the turn

totalTokens.description: Total tokens metered against the org agent-token budget

id.description: Audit entry ID (bigserial, serialised as a string)

userId.description: Acting user; null for system-initiated events

subject.description: What the event was about — flow id, connector key, consent id, anomaly type

destructive.description: Whether the recorded action mutates state irreversibly

egressTarget.description: Host the egress decision applied to

payload.description: Per-kind detail: decisions, counts, hashes and latencies — never raw PII. Shape varies by `kind` (e.g. flow_run: `{ runId, status, steps, egressSteps }`; egress: `{ allowed, reason, residency, mode }`).

limit.description: Effective page size (requested value clamped to 1…500, default 100)

total.description: Global connectors upserted in this run

fromEngine.description: Entries taken from the live flow-engine sidecar's connector list (they win by key)

fromStatic.description: Entries taken from the static native+generic seed

authorizeUrl.description: oauth2 only — the provider authorize URL (state + PKCE challenge embedded). Redirect the browser here; the connection is created by the callback.

keyHint.description: Masked hint for the vaulted secret — never the secret itself

connectorKey.description: Catalog key of the connector this connection authenticates

authType.description: Auth scheme backing the connection; oauth2 connections are refreshed on lease

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'expired' means the OAuth grant is gone (refresh failed definitively) and the connection needs re-authentication.

dataResidency.description: Data-residency label inherited from the connector catalog entry (drives egress governance)

scopes.description: OAuth scopes granted for this connection (empty for api-key/basic)

keyHint.description: Non-reversible masked hint for the vaulted secret — never the secret itself. Null when the vault entry carries no hint.

expiresAt.description: When the OAuth access token expires; null for non-expiring credentials

lastUsedAt.description: When a flow last leased this credential

id.description: Action id, unique within the connector

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the action parameters (shape depends on the connector source)

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the action result (shape depends on the connector source)

egress.description: Whether invoking this action sends data to an external system. Drives the egress chokepoint and the HITL confirmation gate.

organizationId.description: null = global/native connector shared by all orgs; set = org-owned (OpenAPI/MCP import)

key.description: Stable connector key, unique per scope

kind.description: How the catalog entry was sourced

maturity.description: Maturity badge surfaced in the catalog UI

dataResidency.description: Where the connector sends data — drives eu_only / non-EU consent gating

authType.description: Auth scheme a Connection for this connector must use

triggers.description: Events the connector can emit to start a flow

spec.description: Source manifest — the imported OpenAPI document, the MCP server config, or the engine node descriptor. Free-form and never contains secrets; `spec.oauth` may carry the provider-fixed authorize/token endpoints.

iconUrl.description: Icon URL for the catalog UI

enabled.description: Disabled catalog entries are hidden from browse

id.description: Trigger id, unique within the connector

subject.description: What the consent applies to — connector key, tool name or flow id

lifetime.description: Validity window. '30d' sets `expiresAt`; the others do not.

revokedAt.description: When the consent was revoked; null while it stands

active.description: Derived: not revoked and not expired — this is what the gates check

revoked.description: Always true when an unrevoked consent was found and revoked

mode.description: Policy mode. 'allowlist' permits only listed domains, 'blocklist' rejects listed ones, 'eu_only' requires an EU/self-hosted connector (or pii_egress consent).

domains.description: Domain entries; a host matches exactly or as a suffix (sub.example.com ⊇ example.com)

requireConsentNonEu.description: Require pii_egress consent for non-EU / unknown-residency destinations in any mode

redactFields.description: Dot-paths stripped from every payload before it leaves the deployment

configured.description: Present and false only on GET when the org has never saved a policy — the other fields are then the built-in defaults, not stored values. Absent once a policy exists.

latencyMs.description: Round-trip time of the health probe in milliseconds

version.description: Engine version reported by the sidecar

error.description: Why the probe failed, or "No flow engine adapter configured" when none is bound

deleted.description: Always true when the flow was found and deleted

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'active' flows are fired by triggers.

headVersion.description: Version number of the current (head) definition

engine.description: Flow engine the flow compiles to

engineRef.description: Engine-side workflow id, set once the flow has been activated (compiled)

authoredBy.description: Whether a human or the Studio Agent authored the flow

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the flow

definition.description: The portable FlowDefinition graph: `{ schemaVersion, name, inputs[], steps[], edges[] }`. Each step is one of connector_action / studio / ai / transform / condition / subflow with its own field set, carries a unique `key` and a five-phase `phase` (input|check|decide|act|report); edges are `{ from, to, when? }` and the graph must be a DAG. Null when the head version row is missing.

The portable FlowDefinition graph: `{ schemaVersion, name, inputs[], steps[], edges[] }`. Each step is one of connector_action / studio / ai / transform / condition / subflow with its own field set, carries a unique `key` and a five-phase `phase` (input|check|decide|act|report); edges are `{ from, to, when? }` and the graph must be a DAG. Best-effort: it may still be invalid — review it on the canvas before saving. Null when the model returned nothing parseable.

valid.description: True when the generated definition passed structural validation

errors.description: Validation errors for the generated definition (empty when valid)

notes.description: The model's raw reply, truncated — only set when no JSON object could be extracted

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'active' flows are fired by triggers.

headVersion.description: Version number of the current (head) definition

engine.description: Flow engine the flow compiles to

engineRef.description: Engine-side workflow id, set once the flow has been activated (compiled)

authoredBy.description: Whether a human or the Studio Agent authored the flow

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the flow

definition.description: The portable FlowDefinition graph: `{ schemaVersion, name, inputs[], steps[], edges[] }`. Each step is one of connector_action / studio / ai / transform / condition / subflow with its own field set, carries a unique `key` and a five-phase `phase` (input|check|decide|act|report); edges are `{ from, to, when? }` and the graph must be a DAG.

changelog.description: Change note recorded with this version

createdBy.description: ID of the user who authored this version

features.description: Effective tier entitlements. All true when the host binds no FeatureGateService — the plugin only loads under a Pro license, so "no gate" means "add no further restrictions".

advancedGovernance.description: Egress-policy editing and GDPR audit export (Business tier)

maxFlows.description: Max non-archived flows per org; 0 = unlimited

maxFlowRunsPerDay.description: Daily flow-run ceiling per org; 0 = unlimited

maxAgentTokensPerDay.description: Daily agent-token ceiling per org; 0 = unlimited

deleted.description: True when a config existed and was deleted; false when nothing was configured

configured.description: False when this org has no OAuth app configured for the connector — every other field is then absent

connectorKey.description: Connector the OAuth app belongs to

clientId.description: OAuth client ID (public half of the app credentials)

secretHint.description: Non-reversible masked hint for the vaulted client secret — never the secret itself. Null when the vault entry carries no hint.

runsPerMin.description: Runs admitted per minute per org (interactive paths only). §16 Team default: 120.

runsPerDay.description: Runs admitted per UTC day per org. §16 Team default: 5000. A license-tier ceiling may apply a tighter cap on top of this.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Runs allowed to execute at once. Over-cap runs stay queued rather than being dropped. §16 Team default: 8.

egressBytesPerDay.description: Outbound bytes allowed per UTC day. §16 Team default: 1 GiB.

agentTokensPerDay.description: Studio Agent LLM tokens allowed per UTC day. §16 Team default: 1000000. The effective cap is the tighter of this and the license ceiling.

date.description: The UTC day the metered counters belong to (YYYY-MM-DD)

runsLastMin.description: Runs created in the last 60 seconds

revoked.description: Always true when the row was found and deleted

flowVersion.description: Pinned flow version the run executes

status.description: Run state. 'waiting_confirmation' means the HITL preflight found ungranted egress/destructive consents — POST /runs/:id/confirm resumes it.

initiatedBy.description: User who started the run; null for system/event-triggered runs

startedAt.description: When the worker claimed the run; null while queued

finishedAt.description: When the run reached a terminal state; null while queued/running

steps.description: Recorded step timeline in execution order (empty while queued)

flowVersion.description: Pinned flow version the run executes

status.description: Run state. 'waiting_confirmation' means the HITL preflight found ungranted egress/destructive consents — POST /runs/:id/confirm resumes it.

initiatedBy.description: User who started the run; null for system/event-triggered runs

startedAt.description: When the worker claimed the run; null while queued

finishedAt.description: When the run reached a terminal state; null while queued/running

runId.description: ID of the newly queued run

stepKey.description: Step key from the flow definition

stepType.description: Step type from the flow definition

status.description: Step outcome; null when the executor recorded none

egress.description: Whether this step sent data to an external system

inputHash.description: sha256 of the step input — a hash, never the payload (privacy by design)

outputHash.description: sha256 of the step output — a hash, never the payload

error.description: Error message when the step failed

engine.description: Name of the bound flow-engine adapter; null when no engine is configured

aiAvailable.description: Whether the pro-ai plugin's AI gateway is bound (Pro→Pro dependency)

agentEnabled.description: Whether the Studio Agent is usable — needs both pro-ai and the Business entitlement

config.description: Per-type configuration. content_event: `{ event, contentTypes? }`. schedule: `{ cron }` (UTC). connector_event: `{ connector, mode: "poll"|"engine", url?, itemsPath?, idField?, pollIntervalSeconds? }`. inbound_webhook and manual take no config.

enabled.description: A disabled trigger is never fired

slug.description: inbound_webhook only — the public path segment of `POST /api/v1/hooks-pro/:slug`

secretHint.description: inbound_webhook only — non-reversible masked hint for the vaulted HMAC secret. Never the secret; the plaintext is returned only once, at create time.

nextFireAt.description: schedule / polling connector_event — next due fire time (UTC)

active.description: Whether the trigger can actually fire right now. A connector_event trigger in 'engine' mode is stored and validated but not yet realized, so it reports false rather than looking armed (IMP-PRO-INTEG-07).

inactiveReason.description: Set when `active` is false: why the trigger cannot fire yet

secretPlaintext.description: inbound_webhook only — the generated HMAC signing secret, in PLAINTEXT and returned exactly once. It is vaulted server-side and can never be read again (only `secretHint` afterwards). Store it in the calling system now; sign requests as HMAC-SHA256 over `${x-roadbeat-timestamp}.${JSON.stringify(payload)}`.
